name: AL-07
label: Safe D

key_factors: Sewell's incumbency and 10-point Democratic district lean
No polls or expert ratings available
model.rationale: The district's 10-point Democratic lean plus Sewell's incumbency and overwhelming fundraising edge point to a safe Democratic hold, and Polymarket prices her at 98%. With no polls or ratings to contradict the fundamentals, the forecast stays close to the baseline.
model.watch: Any late polling showing a much tighter race or unexpected outside spending against Sewell would warrant a downgrade.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Terri Sewell seeks another term in this majority-Black Alabama district that leans Democratic by about 10 points. She has raised nearly $2 million and holds $3.75 million on hand, dwarfing Republican Ammie Akin's roughly $150,000 raised. No public polls or expert ratings cover the race, but prediction markets give Sewell about a 98% chance of winning.

The fundamentals strongly favor the incumbent: district lean, incumbency, and a decisive money advantage all point the same way. Barring an unforeseen shift, Sewell is positioned for a comfortable win in November.
